Migration.Name: Load images from the org/compiere/images resources instead of an external site
Migration.Comments: The GardenWorld data loads two images from www.adempiere.com, which now redirects to an HTML page, so the images never load: the invoice, order and shipment line print formats wait about 22 seconds for the product image. The same images ship in the package org/compiere/images of ADempiere and are read as class-path resources, as the Logo print format items already do (org/compiere/images/C10030HR.png). Each step only changes the rows that still hold the external URL, so a database without those records applies it without error.

Step.RollbackStatement: UPDATE M_Product SET ImageURL='http://www.adempiere.com/images/f/f5/C32.png' WHERE ImageURL='org/compiere/images/C32.png' AND M_Product_ID IN (126,146)
UPDATE W_Advertisement SET ImageURL='http://www1.adempiere.com/images/AdempiereCom120x60.gif' WHERE ImageURL='org/compiere/images/Adempiere120x60.gif' AND W_Advertisement_ID=100
